info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Creditcard Applications Status-v3-spec
info.description: The Credit Card Applications Status API provides an efficient way to check the status of submitted credit card applications. This endpoint allows businesses to retrieve real-time updates on application statuses, facilitating informed decision-making for both internal stakeholders and customers. Typical consumers include customer service teams and applications processing units who need to provide updates to customers or assess application progress. With this API, organizations can enhance their application tracking processes and improve customer communication.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the current status of all applications. You can use this to monitor progress, determine if there are any issues, and get an overview of application health.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving the status of applications. This should contain the necessary parameters to specify which application's status is being requested.

201.description: Resource created successfully, reflecting the status of the applications.

ListCreditcardApplicationsStatusRequest.description: A string representation of the request body for the GET operation pertaining to application statuses.

ListCreditcardApplicationsStatusResponse.title: Application Status Response

status.description: Indicates whether the application process was successful.

referenceNumber.description: A unique identifier for the operation reference.

resultId.description: The ID of the result associated with the application status.

state.description: Current state of the application process.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the request in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the application status.

audit.description: Details regarding the audit of the application process.

ListCreditcardApplicationsStatusResponse.description: Represents the response for the application status query.

AuditDetails.title: Audit Details

createdBy.description: Identifier of the user or system that created the entry.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the entry was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the process was automated.

AuditDetails.description: Contains information about the audit trail for the application process.

x-processing-time.description: The amount of time, in milliseconds, that the server took to process the request. This value can help clients understand the performance of the operation.
